_help: Copy this file OUTSIDE any git repository (for example ~/job-search/job-alert-filters.json) and fill in your own values. null turns a filter off. Pay is yearly in the alert's currency; hourly pay is converted at 1,950 hours. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
_pay: pay_floor: skip a job when the TOP of its stated pay range is below this. keep_unknown_pay: keep jobs whose alert states no pay (flagged in the report).
_office: max_office_days: most office days a week you accept. high_pay_threshold + high_pay_max_office_days: accept more office days when the top of the pay range reaches the threshold. keep_unknown_office_days: keep jobs that don't say (flagged).
_location: preferred_locations: ranked best first; jobs are sorted by it (use "remote" to rank remote jobs). allowed_locations: if set, skip jobs elsewhere. remote_ok: keep remote jobs even when not in allowed_locations.
_titles: Whole-word matches, case-insensitive, as lists of words or phrases, e.g. ["word one", "word two"].
